title: A review on chloride induced corrosion in reinforced concrete structures: lab and in situ investigation

Advanced tools like 3D laser scanning, X-ray μCT, and optical fiber sensing now outperform traditional methods like HCP and resistivity tests, which often fail to detect chloride-induced corrosion accurately.
